entry_state: The reader can reconstruct the finite bank funding and capital examples while distinguishing accounting balances from prudential measures. Classification and event histories are prerequisites for the forthcoming ECL, commitment draw and purchased-credit-impaired loan calculations.
findings: 259: Twelve-month ECL limits default-event dates, not the dates of consequent shortfalls. SICR and POCI findings remain separate; an unweighted compatible-history family supplies no probability-weighted mean.

259–261: The commitment provision0.5 becomes2 with a separately admitted SICR forecast. Actual funding conditions the joint law and yields loan allowance4; retaining the draw probability or resetting staging both incorrectly give2. Funding and provision-to-allowance transfer are one event.

261–263: The non-POCI loan preserves accrual, forecast revision, credit impairment, collection and write-off in order; negative ending equity−19.5 is retained. The POCI example instead embeds initial losses in price50 and credit-adjusted rate10%, with a signed subsequent allowance−25 after improved expected collection88.

263: Interest8 is gross accretion5.5 less signed allowance unwind−2.5; no second credit gain arises. Final collection70 produces profit20 while contractual shortfall51 remains distinct from legal discharge.

264: The dated POCI extension admits integral cost2, two expected instalments55/60.5 and an explicit ACT/365F convention. The complete cash schedule is discounted at the original rate; the early partial write-off begins at the end of the page and continues265.
Six rendered pages read continuously; completed equation and unit judgments reaffirmed. No new defect confirmed.
